description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets per year, separated into “Untargeted” and “Targeted” categories. The horizontal axis lists years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order and is labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160 with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Each year is represented by a stacked bar with a blue segment for “Untargeted” and a brown segment for “Targeted,” as indicated by the legend titled “Targets” in the upper-left. Early years (2012–2015) show very small totals (approximately 0–3 datasets per year), with 2012 appearing as a small brown-only bar (~1) and 2013 as a small blue-only bar (~2). From 2016 onward, stacked totals increase: 2016 is roughly ~12 total (blue ~3, brown ~9), 2017 ~28 (blue ~12, brown ~16), 2018 ~48 (blue ~20, brown ~28), and 2019 ~65 (blue ~12, brown ~53). The 2020 bar totals about ~130 (blue ~48, brown ~82), and 2021 is the tallest at about ~160 (blue ~66, brown ~94). The final year, 2022, shows a shorter total around ~37 (blue ~10, brown ~27). The bars are not visually emphasized beyond the consistent stacking and color scheme, and no annotations are shown.
